content: The drug is available in a concentration of 5 g/dL (1%). Currently, there is no adequate human data to determine the potential risks of this drug on pregnancy outcomes. It is unknown whether maribavir or its metabolites are present in human or animal milk, their effects on milk production, or their impact on breastfed infants. Category A drugs are generally considered acceptable, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. This medication can be taken with or without food. It should be stored at a temperature of 20-25°C (68-77°F), with permissible excursions to 15-30°C (59-86°F).
